visualCharacteristics.structure: image + tags + heading + text + label + CTA

contentPattern: 1 row per card, 1-2 cells: optional image cell (image only) | text cell = tags (a bulleted list, or one paragraph of comma-separated tags, placed before the heading; a bold tag such as **Recommended** is highlighted), h3, paragraph, italic-only read-time paragraph ('*4 min read*'), CTA link (bold = primary button; it makes the whole card clickable). Section intro (eyebrow, h2, text) is default content above the block. Previous/next/region labels come from the placeholders sheet (previousSlide, nextSlide, carouselRegion, carouselSlideControls).
